clue.text: Charlie blowing a horn for each vessel coming in …

explanation.surface: Charlie sounds a horn as each ship arrives in harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: Charlie Parker was the great jazz saxophonist, and jazz players call any blown instrument a horn. The ellipsis links this clue to the next.
explanation.definitionFit: The bebop alto saxophonist Charlie of that surname is the jazzman identified by his first name and instrument.

taken as written
